STANDING DELEGATION POLICY for this repo, authored by the repo owner. Treat this as a durable request to use the Agent tool: in the cases below you do NOT need to be asked each time.

HOW THESE AGENTS WORK. Every agent except qa-test-engineer is READ-ONLY: they investigate and report, they do not edit files. You remain the single writer for product code. Never describe them to the user as implementing anything, and never fan out parallel writers onto one feature.

FEATURE WORK. When the user describes a feature or a substantial change that touches a covered domain, run this shape:
1. CONSULT FIRST, IN ONE PARALLEL BATCH, before writing code: sync-data-specialist if it touches persistence or sync; infra-terraform if it touches terraform/ or .github/workflows/; debugger if the work starts from a bug, crash, Sentry issue, or failing test; code-architect if it adds a new module or crosses existing boundaries. Fold their findings into the plan.
2. IMPLEMENT YOURSELF, in one coherent pass.
3. REVIEW IN ONE PARALLEL BATCH once it compiles: ui-design-reviewer for new or restyled UI under notes-app/src/; code-reviewer for any diff over roughly 50 lines; qa-test-engineer to add and mutation-check tests.

STANDING TRIGGERS, no need to ask:
- A new module or service, a refactor across existing boundaries, or a new/changed data model or interface spanning more than one surface (native, web, backend) -> code-architect, BEFORE writing code. Do NOT fire it when the change fits inside one existing file or the shape is already obvious; it overlaps the built-in Plan agent, and a cold start is not worth it for routine work.
- notes-app/src/lib/db.ts, notes-app/src/lib/sync/**, backend/app/routers/sync.py -> sync-data-specialist. Silent data loss has bitten this repo repeatedly (seq gaps, identity forks, transaction aborts). Consult it BEFORE the change lands, not after.
- Crash, Sentry issue, failing test, or a "why does X happen" -> debugger, BEFORE writing the fix.
- New or restyled UI under notes-app/src/ -> ui-design-reviewer, once it compiles.
- terraform/ or .github/workflows/ -> infra-terraform, before apply or merge.
- Diff over roughly 50 lines -> code-reviewer on the working diff, before commit or PR.
- A feature or fix that lands with no test coverage -> qa-test-engineer. It writes test files only and mutation-checks each test; it must not touch product code.

RULES:
- Agents that can write product code (general-purpose, claude) still require an explicit request. qa-test-engineer is the sole standing exception and is scoped to test files.
- Launch independent agents in one batch, not serially.
- Do NOT delegate for questions answerable from context, single-file edits, or typo fixes. A cold subagent re-derives context you already have and costs more than it returns there.
- Relay findings in your own words, name which agent produced them, and verify anything surprising before acting on it. Agents are sometimes wrong.
